name: v3 7% line, real money, 7% of exchange shard 2 available cash (the 15-minute crypto shard; compounding), no loss limit
status: FROZEN. Do not edit. Any change needs a new file and a new hash pinned in server/live/kalshi-pilot.js PILOT_SHA256 and the tests. p5 (config/frozen/kalshi-live-pilot.json) is kept unchanged as history.
source: Bryan, 2026-11-01: 'Ok time to set up live trading with Kalshi using the strategies v1 - v3'; pilot bankroll $100 total; go live with v3 only; 'I want it to be the 7% version'. 2026-11-01 (p2): $150 in the MAIN Kalshi account, use the full amount, no subaccount; reuse the desk's existing Kalshi key. Arming needs a separate message from Bryan and a typed phrase on the desk machine. 2026-11-01 (p3): 'I don't want it to only go off of 150. I wanted to go off of the full amount that's in the account... like it compounds.' The $150 bankroll cap is removed; $150 becomes a realized-loss limit. 2026-11-01 (p4): size from exchange shard 0 available cash only (GET /portfolio/balance?exchange_index=0, `balance`), not the combined cash and not portfolio_value. Bryan: 'I don't want there to be a loss cap... we're starting with 150 and that can go to zero I don't care but if it goes all the way up to 5000 and we're still going, let's still keep going. I don't want it to stop just because of this artificial little cap.' The realized-loss limit is removed; arm phrase is plain ARM LIVE. 2026-11-01 (p5): size from exchange shard 2, the shard the 15-minute crypto markets trade on (Kalshi checks cash on the market's own shard); a market whose known exchange_index differs from balanceExchangeIndex is never traded. Everything else as p4. 2026-11-01 (p6): drop the fixed ETH $400 and SOL $250 per-trade dollar caps; every asset (BTC, ETH, SOL) gets the same $5,000 per-trade ceiling. Bryan: "if we fix it now we won't really have to worry in the future". Everything else as p5 (7% of shard 2 cash, 10% of visible volume, open risk <= bankroll, no loss cap, same order rules, halts, phrases and entry window).
money: integer cents for limits; Kalshi amounts parsed exactly to integer micro-dollars
bankrollRule: bankroll = the AVAILABLE CASH of exchange shard balanceExchangeIndex (GET /portfolio/balance?exchange_index=2, field `balance`, cents) + the pilot's own open cost (already out of cash), re-read before each decision (throttled refresh in shadow, a fresh read before every armed slice); no cap, so size compounds. Never the combined cash of all shards, never portfolio_value; pending deposits and other shards' cash are display-only (Kalshi's app/web move cash between shards, API orders don't). No balance read: shadow skips the decision, armed halts. Shard cash below one contract: the pilot stops trading (plain status, not a halt).
account: main account (no subaccount): balance checks compare only the pilot's own fills and fees, never the absolute balance; other positions and orders are never managed or cancelled
openRiskRule: total open risk (the pilot's own open cost + fees) <= the live bankroll
dailyStopNote: OFF so live stays comparable with paper v3 (the paper arms have no daily stop). Code and tests exist; switching on (e.g. 1000 and true) needs a new file and hash.
dailyBudgetSizing: when shrinkToDailyBudget is true and a daily stop is set: before each slice, the worst-case loss (cost + fee if the contract settles NO) of the new contracts plus today's realized loss plus today's open worst-case must stay within the daily stop; size down, or skip if under 1 contract

order.hold: to settlement; the pilot never sells

fees.formula: per order: ceil_to_cent(0.07 * C * P * (1 - P)); real fees always come from Kalshi fill data

ordersRoute: create-order omits exchange_index, so Kalshi auto-routes by ticker to the market's own shard; any order reject (401/403, insufficient_balance, any other 4xx incl. 429) = one attempt then HALT, nothing else sent. A 429 on a READ (balance, deposits) is not a halt: back off and retry the read only
marketShardRule: the market's own exchange_index comes from the public market data the desk already reads (recorder GET /markets discovery; no extra request). Known and different from balanceExchangeIndex: that market is never traded (shadow row skipped, armed slice_skip before any order intent; plain status, not a halt). Unknown: the configured shard is used, and any insufficient_balance reject halts after one attempt.
shardNote: CHECKED 2026-11-01: Kalshi's Exchange Sharding doc lists Crypto under shard 2 for new events, and the public GET /markets and /series show KXBTC15M, KXETH15M and KXSOL15M with exchange_index 2. Kalshi checks collateral on the market's own shard, and only App/Web orders auto-transfer cash between shards (API orders do not). At p5 freeze Bryan's cash was on shard 0 ($72.51) and shard 1 ($7.03) with shard 2 at $0.00, so the pilot shows 'stopped trading' until shard 2 holds cash. The pilot has no transfer code. Changing the sizing shard needs a new file and hash.
stops: no loss limit: the pilot trades until HALT is pressed or a safety stop trips; the balance can go to zero. No per-trade dollar ceiling beyond the asset caps.
